remarks: Welcome to this charming 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home situated on a desirable corner lot in Cypress. Featuring an inviting open floor plan, this home offers a wonderful combination of comfort, space, and functionality. Step inside to a welcoming entry with tile flooring leading to a spacious living room with high ceilings, a formal dining room, and a comfortable family room featuring a cozy fireplace. The remodeled kitchen offers a functional layout that opens to the family and dining areas, making it ideal for everyday living and entertaining.
